nodes.name: Webhook: source job intake
nodes.notes: Accepts a normalized job: { source_url, requested_by, optional_metadata }. We do NOT trust arbitrary public POSTs without auth — for production, gate this webhook behind n8n's built-in auth or a sibling auth node. Returns the run_id synchronously (200) so callers can poll the editorial item.
